architecture_reference.title: Intel 64 and IA-32 Architectures Software Developer's Manual, Volume 3, section 4.10.4.3
architecture_reference.constraint: Absent-to-present insertion can omit invalidation only when prior present-to-absent withdrawal has retired translations. This change does not infer translation absence from a capability's mapping metadata.

production_change: The actual leaf mutation reports InsertedAbsent or ReplacedPresent under BKL. FrameMap skips retirement only for InsertedAbsent; present replacements retain the existing synchronous all-online-CPU retirement. Explicit paging-structure Unmap retires all contexts after physically clearing the table, even if best-effort detach cannot find its recorded parent. The extracted retirement implementation preserves the existing CR4.PGE global/all-PCID flush and every target CPU's acknowledgement; AArch64 behavior is unchanged.
source_review: Independent source review found no blocker. Original exact source-capability, root, ASID, range and rights validation remain. No scheduler/current-CPU guess replaces translation retirement authority.
